svg.title: FIG-10 Independent Source SDK consumers relocate full prefix; Native run != ARM link
svg.desc: clean Git source / locked deps / licenses development fixtures require explicit opt-in; package_source_sdk.prepare / verify Complete installed prefix / manifest / required-file closure; Relocate the complete prefix to an independent root Not only share/nexus/src; find_package(Nexus EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED) independent consumer source / build external NEXUS_ASSEMBLY_FILE; SDK.cmake / resolver boundary verification Actual file hashes / source / dependencies / closure; nexus_add_firmware() public Nexus targets, no vendor header leaks; Native consumer actual Native configure / build / run exit codes and production contracts; ARM consumer Actual startup / system / linker + ELF / BIN / map Selected modes / resources / kernel linkage; Stale identity / changed bytes / missing closure / wrong prefix Reject generation or compilation; never reuse a stale package; verify_consumers report + raw logs + same-artifact identity ARM linking is not physical execution; actual packaging; complete package; independent installation consumer; load public entry; validated; failure; Native assembly; exact MCU assembly; executed results; executed results
